chunks: And by his chain of narration, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

It reached the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) that Abu Ayyub intends to divorce his wife. So the Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'Indeed, the divorce of the mother of Ayyub is a wrongdoing.'

key_terms.أُمِّ أَيُّوبَ: Umm Ayyub, the wife of Abu Ayyub al-Ansari; referred to by her maternal honorific (kunya), emphasizing her respected status as a mother.
key_terms.بَلَغَ: It reached (the Prophet), i.e., news came to him; indicates informal report rather than formal complaint.
key_terms.لَحُوبٌ: A grave sin or wrongdoing; an uncommon classical Arabic word used to emphasize the moral weight of an unjustified divorce.

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet say about divorcing a compatible wife according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: This hadith, narrated by Imam al-Sadiq (AS) via a connecting chain, reports a prophetic intervention to discourage an unnecessary divorce. When the Prophet (SAWW) learned that Abu Ayyub al-Ansari intended to divorce his wife Umm Ayyub, he declared it a moral wrongdoing (حوب). This reflects the Islamic principle that while divorce is legally permissible, it is spiritually and ethically condemned when pursued without valid justification, particularly against a compatible and righteous spouse.

en.hubeali: And by his chain, from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘It reached the Prophet<sup>saww</sup> that Abu Ayoub intends to divorce his wife. So he<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘Divorce of the mother of Ayoub is a wrongdoing’.
en.sarwar: 5. Through the same chain of narrators as that of the previous Hadith, the following is narrated: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that

the Holy Prophet, was informed about abu Ayyub’s divorcing his wife. The Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, then said, ‘Divorcing ‘Umm (mother of) Ayyub is a sin."
